posts.hook: The Nvidia chip scandal now has an alleged line to China's spy agency
posts.caption: the new york times' sources say alice huang, the woman at the center of the nvidia chip scandal, was in touch with an officer of china's spy agency. the us intelligence chief is also becoming acting national cyber director, and a study finds a rules file does not act as a barrier for coding agents. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: NYT sources: Alice Huang was in touch with an MSS officer from spring 2025 until this fall
slides.desc: Anonymous-source claims, not charges, but the story moves from smuggling toward alleged spying.

terms.gloss: china's civilian spy agency, the ministry of state security

slides.title: The US intelligence chief and AI czar is also becoming acting national cyber director
slides.desc: Jay Clayton told CNN to expect "bumps in the road". Now cyber policy is his job too.

slides.title: A study gave four coding agents one rules file. It worked as advice, not as a barrier
slides.desc: One agent's hidden-test score fell from 99.0% to ==67.7%== with the file present.

slides.title: When AI agent runs go wrong, only ==19 of 128== public reports describe a full recovery
slides.desc: Undo and resume are the promised safety net. The public record says it mostly does not hold.

slides.title: xnulinux loads the macOS kernel into Linux as a module, no virtual machine in between
slides.desc: Its README reports macOS booting to the desktop. Apple's code-signing checks are patched.

slides.title: An audit flagged possible privacy violations in 54.5% of agent skills that handle personal data
slides.desc: 307 of 563 skills, all while doing the job they advertise.

posts.hook: Eleven days after resigning over a national security scandal, Jensen Huang has his job back
posts.caption: nvidia's board unanimously reinstated jensen huang as ceo, citing us government input that his return poses no national security risk, while a probe into his conduct continues. crowdstrike is buying zscaler, and amazon is taking most of the ai startup decart for a reported $7.5b. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Nvidia's board unanimously reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, ==11 days== after he resigned
slides.desc: It cites US government input that his return "poses no national security risk". Shares rose 30%+.

slides.title: The White House says Trump was "totally involved" in getting Huang back
slides.desc: A Semafor source says he dialed into the board meeting. A probe into Huang's conduct is ongoing.

slides.title: CrowdStrike is buying Zscaler, pulling network security and zero trust into Falcon
slides.desc: One vendor for the agent on the laptop and the service its traffic passes through.

terms.gloss: checking every connection instead of trusting the office network

slides.title: Amazon is acquiring most of Decart, founders and researchers included, for a reported ==$7.5B==
slides.desc: Amazon calls it AI optimization technology, meant to advance its chip and model work.

slides.title: Crunchbase's new model values the world's unicorns at about $11T, not the $9T on paper
slides.desc: Estimates, not prices: the next rounds and exits will show how much of the $2T is real.

terms.gloss: private startups valued at $1 billion or more

slides.title: Ladybird, the browser building its own engine, is now in alpha
slides.desc: Every mainstream browser runs on one of three engines. An alpha lets outsiders judge a fourth.
